embedding_feasibility: High if implemented as contrastive or teacher-distilled representation tuning; classic token SFT is only relevant when a generative wrapper exists
rerank_feasibility: High for cross-encoder and generative reranker format, rationale and list calibration
opd_or_rl_role: Not applicable; this is supervised alignment
required_data: Positive pairs, hard negatives, instructions, list labels, teacher scores
verification_gate: Recall@K, NDCG@K, MTEB/MMEB style transfer, domain holdout

embedding_feasibility: Low to medium; feasible as experimental policy over retrieval actions but not a default vector-training recipe
rerank_feasibility: Medium to high when reward directly scores ordered candidates or downstream answerability
opd_or_rl_role: RL optimizes rerank policy, query reformulation, retrieval-agent actions or generated reasoning
required_data: Reward model or deterministic ranking metrics, stable candidate generator, logged online data
verification_gate: Offline reward correlation, counterfactual replay, A/B guardrails, latency budget

embedding_feasibility: Medium; usually affects embedding only through distilled labels after rerank policy improves
rerank_feasibility: High if candidate set, reward and judge are well controlled
opd_or_rl_role: RL can optimize NDCG, answerability, calibrated list order and reasoning fidelity
required_data: Listwise judgments, task rewards, judge calibration, negative audits
verification_gate: NDCG/MRR plus hallucination and judge-hacking checks

embedding_feasibility: Low as a direct method because embeddings do not expose token-level on-policy trajectories
rerank_feasibility: Medium when reranker emits reasoning or textual decisions before score distillation
opd_or_rl_role: OPD generates better student-state supervision; final vector model still trains with contrastive/distillation losses
required_data: Teacher access, student rollouts, rationales, positive/negative remapping
verification_gate: Distribution-shift analysis, embedding transfer after distillation, cost accounting

embedding_feasibility: Medium to high for generative or reasoning-enhanced rerankers
rerank_feasibility: High when teacher feedback can score student trajectories without leaking labels
opd_or_rl_role: OPD bridges SFT and RLVR, reducing drift before sparse reward optimization
required_data: SFT traces, teacher token feedback, hard multimodal examples, RL reward set
verification_gate: Before/after RLVR delta, token-level drift, visual grounding audit

embedding_feasibility: High for document image and PDF-style retrieval; not a single-vector solution
rerank_feasibility: Medium; late interaction can replace or precede rerank
opd_or_rl_role: Usually trained supervised/contrastive, then optionally distilled into lighter retrievers
required_data: Page images, text queries, visual document labels, OCR or layout metadata
verification_gate: ViDoRe-style recall, page latency, index size, OCR-free error taxonomy
